hibernate-mapping.query: select f from DienstReservering as f where f.contractId = :ContractId order by f.gereserveerdVan asc
select f from DienstReservering as f where f.contractId = :ContractId and f.gereserveerdVan >= :BeginDatum and f.gereserveerdTot < :EindDatum order by f.gereserveerdVan asc
from DienstReservering as d where d.gereserveerdVan >= :BeginDatum and d.gereserveerdTot <= :EindDatum
